labeled_from: Prepared remarks, CFO sections beginning 'Next to segment guidance' and 'Now, back to Company guidance'.
notes: Call of 2020-10-27, guiding the December 2020 quarter. Microsoft's fiscal year ends in June, so the period guided is FY2021Q2 -- the second quarter of the fiscal year closing June 2021. Chosen for segment-level revenue guidance, which the other gold calls don't exercise: the three reportable segments are guided as explicit ranges, and metric_detail is the only thing distinguishing them, which is exactly the case where the eval's match key does count metric_detail. COGS has no dedicated metric in the enum and is labeled 'other' with a detail. Deliberately not labeled: the growth-rate and directional guidance in the same passage ('Gaming, we expect revenue growth in the high 20% range', 'hardware revenue growth of approximately 40%', 'Search ex-TAC... decline in the mid to high-single-digit range', 'full-year double-digit revenue growth'). Those state a rate of change rather than a level, and the schema has no metric for a growth rate, so this gold set covers levels only.

items.source: In Productivity and Business Processes, we expect revenue between $12.75 billion and $13 billion.
For Intelligent Cloud, we expect revenue between $13.55 billion and $13.8 billion.
In More Personal Computing, we expect revenue between $13.2 billion and $13.6 billion.
We expect COGS of $13.75 billion to $13.95 billion and operating expense of $11.4 billion to $11.5 billion.
